_comment: The entity record. This is the foundation for everything else — an AI that
cannot resolve who this business is cannot recommend it, no matter how good
the rest of the content is.
Replace every TODO. Anything left as TODO is treated as missing and will not
The phone number is the canonical NAP number. It must match the Google
Business Profile and every directory listing character for character.
Tracking numbers belong on AI-specific landing pages, never here.
name: TODO — the name customers know, e.g. TitanZ Plumbing
legalName: TODO — registered legal entity name, if different
description: TODO — two or three plain sentences. What the company does, who it serves, what it is known for. This is what an AI paraphrases when introducing the business.
gbpUrl: TODO — Google Business Profile URL. The strongest corroboration signal there is.
responseTime: TODO — a citable specific, e.g. 'Same-day service, within 2 hours for emergencies'
_hoursComment: Set isClosed true for days you are closed.
If you genuinely answer the phone 24/7, say so — it is one of the most
commonly asked and most citable facts in home services.
